info.title: Freundebuch API
info.description:
A personal CRM for two: people, the conversations with them, and what to remember before the next one.

Every error is JSON, `{"error": "...", "code": "..."}`. Besides the responses listed per operation, an unknown path under /api/v1 answers 404 (`not_found`), a method an operation doesn't have answers 405 with `Allow`, and a failure on the server's side answers 500 (`internal`) without details.

post.summary: Record a ramble and its parts
post.description: One ramble, split into conversations, journal entries and items; each item may be `in` one of its conversations. Everything lands in one transaction: a bad part leaves nothing behind. A private ramble makes every part private; journal entries are private unless `shared`. A new person named like an existing person or alias is `ambiguous` (409, listing the candidates) unless `confirmedNew`.
